scope: Read-only review of elec/src/interlock_unit.ato and zapote/interlock documentation at the canonical worktree HEAD. No native/ERC/DRC/powered-board acceptance claimed.

findings.title: Flip-flop Q and QBAR mapping corrected
findings.detail: SN74LVC1G74 uses Q=pin 5 and QBAR=pin 3; the local source matches the manufacturer map. Earlier plain-text assumptions had these reversed.

findings.title: TPS3823 pin map corrected locally
findings.detail: TPS3823 uses RESET_N=1, GND=2, MR_N=3, WDI=4, VDD=5. The standalone definition is correct; the legacy shared definition remains outside this review.

findings.title: Fault-dominant no-autorestart behavior
findings.detail: Seven active-high faults are inverted into healthy inputs; the eighth NAND input is watchdog-good AND SENSOR_LIVE. The NAND output is inverted into CLR_N. With D and PRE_N high, fault removal releases clear without setting Q; only a fresh falling RESET_N request creates the inverted positive CLK edge.

findings.title: Watchdog pull-down and timing
findings.detail: The 1 kΩ WDI pulldown is the value TI Rev O recommends to prevent high-impedance WDI from disabling the watchdog. WDI is retriggered by negative transitions. TPS3823 timeout is 0.9–2.5 s, typical 1.6 s; reset delay is 120–300 ms, typical 200 ms. The 10 kΩ claim from an earlier review was incorrect and is superseded by this record.

findings.title: HC30 3.3 V VIH is not directly tabulated
findings.detail: CD74HC30 guaranteed VIH points are specified at 2 V, 4.5 V, and 6 V, not 3.3 V. Do not apply the 2 V row to this rail. LVC14A-to-HC30 operation is plausible but needs interface qualification or a gate with an explicit 3.3 V VIH guarantee.

findings.title: SENSOR_LIVE producer and remote power-off behavior remain open
findings.detail: SENSOR_LIVE is correctly receiver-pulldown biased but has no qualified producer in the existing units. Remote push-pull fault outputs are not power-off isolation; a receiver pullup can source approximately 346.5 µA into an unpowered output.

limits: No files other than this review JSON and zapote/interlock/memory/closeout-review.md were edited.
No native/ERC/DRC, powered startup, brownout, watchdog elapsed-time, metastability, or downstream gate-shutdown result is claimed.
